basis: Fresh repaired-candidate Ghidra/P-Code comparison, exact AArch64 instruction and relocation parity, two reproducible Docker builds with identical module hashes, strict Joern scope/slice, direct helper host coverage, and KCFI direct-call-only applicability check.
limitations: This is static/offline function-level evidence; hardware behavior on NX809J remains unverified.

The Ghidra semantic comparison uses only the explicit candidate-side data-field-slice normalization and removal of the known global-warning comment after exact body and P-Code checks; broad decompiler fallbacks are disabled.
The KCFI direct-call check is not applicable because gf_enable_irq has kcfi_required=false and no validated indirect-call surface was requested.
The promotion does not claim that the remaining unpromoted fp_goodix functions are complete.
